title: Allocation Lab ResearchRunSpec
description: Canonical Phase A research request contract derived from backend behavior audited at commit b9950f7cbe128f9d761597a5e216d777cc3059a3. An accepted field does not imply that every audited mode implements it.

$schema.x-validation-rules: When present, it identifies the schema used to validate the record.
$schema.x-backend-mapping: Evidence-adapter metadata; excluded from run identity.

contract_version.description: Version of the research-run interchange contract, distinct from financial engine versions.
contract_version.x-validation-rules: Must equal this Phase A draft version.
contract_version.x-backend-mapping: Evidence-adapter metadata; excluded from run identity.

run_id.description: Deterministic identity of the normalized economic request and its reproducibility inputs.
run_id.x-validation-rules: rr_ followed by the lowercase SHA-256 defined in research-run-contract.md.
run_id.x-backend-mapping: Workbench identity; scenario jobs retain separate engine job_hash values.

created_at.description: UTC time when the immutable request record was created; it does not affect financial output.
created_at.x-validation-rules: RFC 3339 timestamp normalized to UTC with a Z suffix.
created_at.x-backend-mapping: Request-record metadata; excluded from run identity.

research_mode.description: Financial research domain whose committed implementation is requested; the value alone does not imply empirical support.
research_mode.x-validation-rules: Must use the uppercase contract enum.
research_mode.x-backend-mapping: CAPITAL_MARKET_EXPOSURE maps to research/capital/engine.ts runCampaign; other mappings are capability-gated before dispatch.

execution_scope.description: Separates recalculation from historical observations, synthetic mechanical tests, and frozen empirical replay.
execution_scope.x-validation-rules: EMPIRICAL is valid only when all ten Phase A empirical criteria pass.

universe.description: Separates instruments that receive capital from instruments used only for prediction or reference information.
universe.x-validation-rules: Both arrays are explicit, nonempty, unique, and order-preserving; order is part of identity because the current engine hashes arrays in supplied order.
universe.x-backend-mapping: Capital Campaign.risk_asset and Campaign.reference_universe; allocation modes map to their allocator-universe contracts.

start_date.description: Inclusive start of the requested validation schedule, not necessarily the first emitted OOS observation.
start_date.x-validation-rules: YYYY-MM-DD; earlier than end_date and inside data coverage. Capital month boundaries must fall on day 01.

end_date.description: Exclusive end of the requested validation schedule.
end_date.x-validation-rules: YYYY-MM-DD; later than start_date and no later than snapshot coverage permits. Capital month boundaries must fall on day 01.

information_cutoff_policy.description: Declares which information may be visible for fitting, prediction, allocation, and execution.
information_cutoff_policy.x-validation-rules: PIT_SAFE is forbidden unless every applicable PIT evidence field defined in the contract is present and verified. The Phase A capital proof uses PIT_MECHANICS_ENFORCED_DATA_VINTAGE_UNVERIFIED.
information_cutoff_policy.x-backend-mapping: Capital predictor cutoff checks, fit-window bounds, and calculator executionTiming.

benchmark.description: Comparison series or policy; NOT_SUPPORTED is the explicit sentinel when no benchmark result exists.
benchmark.x-backend-mapping: No benchmark output exists in the selected capital engine.

strategy_or_allocator_id.description: Stable identifier of the strategy, selector, or allocator being executed.
strategy_or_allocator_id.x-validation-rules: Must resolve to committed callable source; derived contract labels must be declared as such.
strategy_or_allocator_id.x-backend-mapping: capital-research-grid-selector is a derived contract label for the capital campaign selector; selected candidate IDs are emitted in ResearchRunResult.

strategy_or_allocator_version.description: Semantic version of the selected strategy or allocator.
strategy_or_allocator_version.x-validation-rules: Must match the executing implementation and be repeated in provenance.

parameters.description: Complete, explicitly expanded mode-specific model and economic parameter set.
parameters.x-validation-rules: No silent defaults. Every result-affecting engine default is expanded before hashing; JSON forbids nonfinite numbers.
parameters.x-backend-mapping: Capital candidate specification, policy grid, selection metric, yields, slippage, and fold initialization.

rebalance_frequency.description: Cadence at which risky exposure or portfolio targets may be refreshed.
rebalance_frequency.x-validation-rules: Must be a cadence implemented by the selected mode; capital candidates accept monthly or quarterly.

transaction_cost_bps.description: One-way cost charged on absolute traded notional, in basis points.
transaction_cost_bps.x-validation-rules: Required, finite, and nonnegative. Zero costs are encoded as numeric 0. The selected adapter maps one scalar to a committed cost scenario.
transaction_cost_bps.x-backend-mapping: Capital job scenario and calculator BacktestConfig.transactionCostBps.

expected_return_method.description: Expected-return method where an allocator objective requires one.
expected_return_method.x-validation-rules: Explicit object when used; NOT_APPLICABLE for the selected capital path. FUTURE_NOT_IMPLEMENTED never authorizes execution.
expected_return_method.x-backend-mapping: No expected-return estimate is consumed by the selected capital engine.

covariance_method.description: Covariance method and version where portfolio allocation requires one.
covariance_method.x-validation-rules: Explicit object when used; a method name cannot substitute for a PIT covariance artifact.
covariance_method.x-backend-mapping: No covariance estimate is consumed by the selected capital engine.

risk_mandate.description: Versioned limits, cash rules, and exposure rules where an allocation mode consumes a RiskMandate.
risk_mandate.x-validation-rules: Expanded and versioned when used; explicit sentinel otherwise.
risk_mandate.x-backend-mapping: The selected capital path uses exposure-policy parameters, not allocation-core RiskMandate.

constraints.description: Feasibility and acceptance bounds applied to candidates or allocations.
constraints.x-validation-rules: All active bounds and units are explicit; defaults are expanded.
constraints.x-backend-mapping: Capital Campaign.constraints or allocation-core constraints, depending on mode.

validation_protocol.description: Defines how fitting, selection, validation or inner OOS, and outer OOS remain separate.
validation_protocol.x-validation-rules: Ranges are half-open; training_end_exclusive is no later than outer_oos_start. Fold order is material and preserved.
validation_protocol.x-backend-mapping: Capital validation_mode, window_type, fold builder, and selection rule.

walk_forward_configuration.description: Walk-forward window lengths and recalibration cadence.
walk_forward_configuration.x-validation-rules: Object required for traditional/nested execution; current capital engine rejects overlapping test windows.
walk_forward_configuration.x-backend-mapping: Capital train_months, test_months, step_months, and recalibration_frequency.

random_seed.description: Seed controlling stochastic search or engine behavior.
random_seed.x-validation-rules: Included in identity whenever randomness applies; NOT_APPLICABLE for deterministic execution.
random_seed.x-backend-mapping: Capital Campaign.random_seed for random search; the selected grid path is deterministic.

data_snapshot.description: Immutable identity, coverage, and provenance qualification of every historical input used by the run.
data_snapshot.x-validation-rules: Local input is committed; bytes and parsed observations match their hashes; coverage_start is no later than coverage_end.
data_snapshot.x-backend-mapping: Campaign.data_csv, data_sha256, committed bytes, parser result, and source metadata.

engine_versions.description: Versions and code identity of every engine, model, and policy contributing to the result.
engine_versions.x-validation-rules: All contributing components are explicit; the entire object participates in identity.
engine_versions.x-backend-mapping: Capital ENGINE_VERSION, model/policy registry versions, and aggregate code hash.

code_commit.description: Git commit supplying committed executable source and inputs.

requested_by.description: Audit identity of the requester; it does not alter financial output.
requested_by.x-backend-mapping: Request metadata; excluded from run identity.

storage_policy.description: Persistence and cache policy for auditable evidence; it does not alter economics.
storage_policy.x-validation-rules: All output roots are explicit and immutable records reject identity mismatch.
storage_policy.x-backend-mapping: runCampaign root and capital immutable artifact store.

x-default-policy: NO_SILENT_DEFAULTS: expand every result-affecting default before canonicalization; explicitly encode transaction_cost_bps as 0 when costs are zero.
x-current-empirical-mapping: research/capital/engine.ts runCampaign and its committed Campaign configuration
